notes.title: Upcoming Update: American Tear-Trip
notes.notes:
https://i.ibb.co/nNFChrpF/US-Road-Trip.png

Hi everyone!

Firstly, apologies for being away so long, I'm the only dev working on Beyond Hanwell and a lot has been happening in my personal life that's kept me away from the boards for a while but I've been slowly pressing on with some new content.

It's feature will an be American Tear-Trip! Travel to the US embassy, with a surprising journey further afield, there just aren't any decent bagels in London.

New enemy, weapons and Mid-Atlantic location to explore.

I initially wanted the update out last week, but it's going to take a little longer and I don't want to rush it so please keep an eye on your update feed!

Cheers!
Nathan

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Fixed reverb issues that would cause overly loud audio that occurs when kicking some doors.
 Steam Deck changes, optimised Steam Deck settings are applied at launch to comply with Valve guidelines. Verification should hopefully follow.
 New Location - Resident Baths, just a small location I was working on a while ago that was never fully completed. It's still an interesting place to enter, grab a special weapon, some ammo and maybe some little bonus inventory.
 Added dead zone on controller input. Eliminating drift when playing with a controller.

notes.title: 1.0 Hotfix #2 - Fatal Error Resolved
notes.notes:
Fixed "Fatal Error" issue on some systems.
 Chainsaw and Cursed Weapons sound effects now fade out as they should when stowed.

notes.title: 1.0 Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Fixed cancelling use in the inventory also dropping the item when playing on a controller.
Added more checkpoints to the hospital.
Fixed a bug that would prevent Dinky, Minxy and the Duke not taking damage with melee.

notes.title: Beyond Hanwell Update 1.0
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=B_f2MEcxFzA;full][/previewyoutube]

Major Changes
 New Game+ - Start a new game, straight to Westminster with all you're upgrades and inventory. Available after completing the main game.
 Non-essential items can now be dropped from the inventory. Just right click and drag outside the inventory area to drop an item, dropped items can be retrieved again.
 Headbob is back, I disabled head bobbing before launching due to bugs caused in the latest version of UE5, it is now back. It is on by default but can be disabled in the settings.
 Removed sprint delay when not using the quick turn feature.
 Added attack homing options for radius and distance. This helps you tailor the combat to your specific play style, if you are quick with a mouse you can set the radius lower but if you are not so quick or using a controller, you might set it higher.

New Locations
 Clayfield Auditorium - Enter the Clayfield Auditorium Circus and face the challenges that the ringmaster has in store.
 Squalid House
 Little Minster
 Ministry of Truth - Shhh! Watch out for Sleepers, terrifying instakill enemies that sleep until disturbed. Perhaps the scariest location in the whole game!
 Sleeper Train - Triggered after a few tube rides.
 No. 1 Haven Meadow
 No. 12 Haven Meadow
New Testing Grounds Locations
 Palace of Westminster
 Royal Hallamshire
New Enemy
Sleeper, don't get too close, and be quiet! Sleepers are extremely dangerous, hit this from afar with your gun, or run away.

New Weapons
 Special Weapons, special weapons can be found in the world, usually locked behind a small challenge and can be collected more than once.
 Cursed Sacrificial Dagger
 Cursed Radiant Cross
 Mace of Flames and it's blueprint for crafting.
 Zombie Knife
 Frying Pan - The frying pan is back! Anybody who played Welcome to Hanwell might remember the stupidly overpowered Frying Pan, well it's back, and just as stupid and silly as ever.
New Items
 Flare - Can be dropped to light up an area for a set time.
 SAMPLE-42 - Deadly manufactured virus.
 Smoke Bomb - Fills an area with smoke that will block the line of sight of enemies.
 Pistol Torch Attachment - Permanently upgrades the pistol with a light source, it isn't as bright as the main torch, but it will help in a dark room full of Anomalies.

Changes and bug fixes
 Added options for subtitle size.
 Attack homing will no longer be triggered on a friendly Dinky.
 Dinky will now travel with you between locations.
 Added scrolling to the blueprint selection paper.
 Glowsticks now last 3 times longer.
 Fixed an issue with clearing Hotel Great Western when you have a bigger bag than the one available in the location.
 Glowsticks now activate even when the animation is interrupted.
 Improved performance in Westminster on Steam Deck.
 Cleaned up some holes in meshes when running on Steam Deck or in DirectX 11.
 Enhanced gunshot sounds - Both the pistol and the shotgun firing sounds have had a makeover, making them sound more punchy and powerful.
 Reworked the tutorials, tutorial messages are now less intrusive.
 Fixed up some audio issues with reload sounds not being spatialised.
 Added settings to disable FOV and Vignette effects when sprinting.
 Added more checkpoints in the Theatre.
 Added settings to increase the player walk speed by 33%.
 Added settings to turn off the aiming walk speed modifier.
 Added settings to adjust the amount the look sensitivity is affected when attacking with melee weapons.
 Reduced the hit radius of the interaction trace, and increased it's distance.
 Adjusted the detection range of certain pickups for more reliable prompt "E" or "A" prompt display.
 Increased the amount of ammo when picking up ammo boxes on Normal difficulty.
 Changes to the Stalker AI to stop them blocking doors if they finish stalking without waking.

notes.title: Update 0.75.1
notes.notes:
Added a Return to Westminster button in the pause menu, this will load your backup save and return you to your last save point in Westminster.
 Added Objectives to Livingstone Manor
 Inventory Management - You can now re-arrange your inventory. Do this by holding down the right mouse button, and dragging your item to a different slot. On controllers this is mapped to the jump button. Y by default, or whatever you mapped it to if using a custom remap.
 New Special Cursed Radiant Cross weapon found in the woods. - I'll be adding more special one off items to the open world over the next, just little unique bits to make exploration more rewarding.
 Fixed torch battery consume issues with low battery.

notes.title: 0.75 Hotfix
notes.notes: Livingstone Manor now clears as it should.

notes.title: Early Access Update 0.75
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=B_Cpe63gkH4;full][/previewyoutube]

Major Changes

 As requested. Added Story Difficulty Mode, playing on this difficulty level will make the combat and survival elements of the game much more forgiving. - Important Note! Because of the new difficulty tier, you're saved difficulty will have decreased by 1. So if you were on Normal, you will now be on Easy, be sure to check and change this to your preferred level.
 Testing Grounds - New arcade style game mode available after completing the main game. Set your parameters and fight a never ending wave of Anomalies. Only St Pauls is currently available, but I'll add more with each update!
 Added support for Intel's XeSS upscaling technology.
 Experimental Steam Deck Support, first time run on Steam Deck will automatically set optimal settings, and fixed the "Requires C++" dialogue issue. Note: Steam Deck still has quirks, there are lots of visual anomalies (broken looking meshes, for example on the hospital) and Westminster performance is a little slow in places, but all playable. I'll be working to fix these in the coming days.
 Can now carry more crafting materials by default, this can be further increased by finding the bags and increasing inventory size.
 Added Controller Remapping - Another popular request and it's now in. Not extensively tested so please let me know if you run into issues with this.

New Locations

 Livingstone Manor - Explore the home of an eccentric billionaire Mataus Livingstone, Duke of Westminster, crazed with an obsession of doll making. 
 ATF Camp - Exterior location found in Westminster
 Greywood Chapel - Exterior location found in Westminster

New Anomalies

 Flaming Duke of Westminster
 Dinky
 Minxy

New Weapons and Blueprints

 Dinky, craft an anomalous doll to fight on your side for a short time.
 Themed weapon, Sacrificial Dagger in Livingstone Manor

Small Changes and Bug Fixes

 Cleaned up the side location clearance code. Hopefully solving the "Cleared" markers once and for all!
 Doubled the torch battery life.
 FSR Quality Mode Changes - Because FSR quality mode selection isn't setting the resolution scale as it should (I think this is a bug with the current UE5 implementation of the FSR Plugin), I've enabled manual setting of Resolution Scale with FSR, this will give you fine tune control over the internal resolution when using FSR in place of the usual quality modes.
 Fixed movement input remaining when pausing the game.

Note: Squalid House was supposed to be included in this update, but I got carried away with the mansion, specifically, the addition of a Dinky timed ally was a last minute idea and took me a very long time. Squalid House will be added soon.

notes.title: 0.5.2 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Locked the Hanwell Bypass until you have all ID cards.

This update seems larger than it's content because it also comes with the ground work for tomorrows big 0.75 content update.

Please note, that means it comes with the new Story difficulty mode. Because of the new difficulty tier, you're saved difficulty will have decreased by 1. So if you were on Normal, you will now be on Easy, be sure to check and change this to your preferred level.

See you all tommorow!

Because it could ruin your experience and allow you to do the end before the beginning, this was a rushed update, so as ever, if I broke anything, please let me know and I'll get right on a fix.

notes.title: Update 0.5.1
notes.notes:
Fixed some map icon issues when cleared.
 Fixed a bug that would cause the torch to become unusable after using a battery.
 Fixed the rotation axis of the Ferris Wheel in Anomaly Park. (I think, this one is random so I hope my changes fixed it)
 Fixed a bug that would trigger already triggered checkpoints.
 Added 5 seconds of invincibility on load and health is no longer saved to avoid getting into an infinite death loop.
 Some random crafting materials can now be found in safe houses.
 Added tutorial for perfect block.
 Added tutorial to clarify health regeneration.
 Reworked the failsafe in Twitchys to ensure you cannot get soft locked if he doesn't drop the key. If this happens, just restart checkpoint and the door will unlock.
 Added a 1024 Texture Streaming Pool Size option, this is experimental to see if I can solve some GPU crash issues on certain AMD Cards. If you have experienced GPU crashes, please try using this setting and let me know if it helps.
 As a massive Easter Egg, you can now find the Test Map, the map I used to test everything which includes all upgrades, weapons, enemies and every system in the game. It's very hard to find but I put it in to make testing easier for myself. I thought I'd mention it here for anyone that likes an easter egg challenge, just be aware entering this location could completely screw up your save, so tread lightly :D.

notes.title: 0.5 Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that would cause the torch to flicker and dim with full battery.

notes.title: Beyond Hanwell 0.5 Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=gdyGPFysWzg;full][/previewyoutube]
Major Changes
Reworked the torch, the torch will no longer die completely, rather when the battery gets low it will just dim and flicker, the battery will also last much longer. To balance this, batteries are now slightly less common, and more likely to be used in crafting.

New Content
Makeshift Melee Weapons can now be created at Workbenches from crafting materials. Makeshift weapons are much more powerful than almost any weapons that can be found (except special weapons dropped by certain bosses) but will wear slightly faster for it's class.

New Locations
Anomaly Park 
Restore power to Anomaly Park and enter to discover it's secrets.
The Amazing Adventures of Twitchy
Explore a long forgotten haunted house attraction in the heart of Anomaly Park.

New Anomalies
Twitchy
Fight Twitchy in Twitchy's Amazing Adventure in Anomaly Park.
Animal-Tronics
Fight Twitchy's minions in Anomaly Park.

New Weapons

 3 new Blueprints to discover that grant the ability to create 3 of the new makeshift weapons. Maceball Bat, Axe the Awful and Bolty Pickaxe.
 1 New regular blueprint to discover, Tricksters Dynamite.
 New themed juggler weapon found in Anomaly Park.

Small Changes and Bug Fixes

 Crafting ammo no longer gives you a random amount, you get 10 shots for each box crafted.
 Added more crafting materials to the world.
 Fixed some main locations not showing as cleared when complete.
 Fixed pathfinding in the Hanwell Maintenance Tunnel.
 Fixed some Anomalies not being alerted of the player when they take damage.
 Fixed some guide icons not displaying when they should.
 Added failsafe triggers for achievements in case of bugged achievement events.
 Added a failsafe against entering Expenco, collecting the fuel but not using it in the generator, leaving and using it elsewhere then returning to no fuel and no way to start the generator.

notes.title: 0.4.5 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that would prevent you from activating the lift in Hanwell.

This brings the game back from it's reverted state and into 0.4.5 so new features are back such as perfect block.

I'm halfway through 0.5 too so this hotfix comes with the new torch system, which was supposed to come in 0.5. The torch will now dim and flicker instead of becoming unusable when the battery is low.

notes.title: Update 0.4.5
notes.notes:
Major Changes
Perfect Block
If you block at just the right moment as an enemy attack lands, you will execute a perfect block, stunning the enemy for a moment and allowing you to get an easy couple of shots on it, this works especially well if you follow up with a perfect combo. During this stun period, enemies will take slightly more damage. Note that some bosses are immune to this for the sake of the difficulty curve.

Small Changes and Bug Fixes

 Map icons are no longer covered by weather effects. Note the weather will still cover the drone map when extremely foggy or in an Anomalous storm, but the icons will remain clear. This is by design as would be expected if using a drone in real life.
 Fixed a bug that would cause EastForge Surplus to be inaccessible if you added fuel to the generator, left and then re-entered Expenco Hall without picking up the IR Goggles.
 Fixed a bug that would cause the forklift sound effect to loop endlessly in EastForge.
 Fixed an exploit that would allow you to jump into the crypt in St Pauls without first solving the puzzle.
 Fixed an exploit that would allow you to trap King William V and endlessly stomp without taking damage.
 Fixed a bug with some of the info boards that would lock the players movement and cause strange behaviour when interacting after the fact.


Note, I know some people have requested I break up the pak files for smaller patching, but this is introducing very horrible stuttering when wandering Westminster, until I can solve this issue, I'll need to stick with the IO Store and single pak file. I'll be pushing non essential updates to the default branch less often to balance this.

However, if you have about 30-40gb free space on your SSD, this shouldn't be an issue.

notes.title: Update 0.4.4
notes.notes:
Rebalanced The Speaker boss fight on Easy Difficulty.
 Lowered the volume of the death sound.
 Increased the amount of ammo that can be carried, can be further increased by finding backpacks that increase inventory space.
 Batteries now auto-consume when the torch runs out.
 Repositioned out of place books in St Pauls.
 Added music to the end of The Palace of Westminster.
 Fixed some collision issues in the Palace of Westminster.
 Moved the speakers in The New Lyceum to prevent access to the stage before beating The Grand Stalker.
 Rebalanced the music in The New Lyceum and fixed sync issues.
 Added a backup save, which will return you to your last save in Westminster as a failsafe in case of issues in new locations coming in 0.5.

notes.title: Update 0.4.3
notes.notes:
Minor revision with the following changes:


 Switched boss fight weapons to respawn when player dies.
 Fixed the combat music playing after enemies are defeated in St Pauls.
 Fixed dim screens in The Palace of Westminster.
 Fixed some check marks not showing up after completing certain side locations.

This will be the last small update (except any bug reports that I will fix as they come in) until next week. I'm aiming to have the first major update, 0.5 out next Friday (7th September) with a bunch new content such as new blueprints, weapons and locations.

notes.title: 0.4.2 Hotfix 1
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that would cause you to become stuck if entering Steel Arts Software more than once.

notes.title: Update 0.4.2
notes.notes:
This will be the last update from me tonight, just another revision to fix up a few things and add some requested features.


 Added a checkmark on cleared locations in the drone map. (Unfortunately this won't trigger retroactively for older saves, but it is purely cosmetic and won't affect your gameplay experience.)
 Added Zoom Remap Setting.
 Fixed missing collision on pallets in the Underground.
 Fixed a bug that would cause an infinite load screen when accessing a previously cleared main location.


Thank you all who have played so far and thanks for your patience as I ironed out some initial bugs. I'll be back to it tomorrow! Now I'm off to sleep.

Thanks again!
Nathan

notes.title: 0.4.1 Hotfix

Fixed a nasty bug that would push you back to the main menu when trying to enter North House Media and corrupt your save.

If you were affected by this bug your save will be automatically recovered and you will launch into the building you were trying to enter when you hit continue.

notes.title: Beyond Hanwell 0.4.1 - Bug fixes and new settings.
notes.notes:
This revision includes the following chages:


 Added a block to the window in Anomaly Park.
 Added a exposure compensation (brightness) slider.
 Added a sensitivity slider for the modifier when sprinting.
 Fixed a bug that would cause a dummy load screen to show when continuing, but no save file is found.
 Fixed a bug that would cause weapons to randomly drop when loading into a new area.
 Fixed an issue with mouse sensitivity that would cause sensitivity to drop at high framerates.

notes.title: 0.4.0 Hotfix #2
notes.notes: Fixed the bug that would cause infinate load screen when trying to access an Early Access flagged location.

notes.title: 0.4.0 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Fixed a minor bug that would cause the final mission to re-register each time you enter Westminster.
Added an exit prompt to the Drone Map.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
I wanted to bring the demo in line with the full games current state for the Early Access launch next month. This should provide a good benchmark to test the game on your hardware and be sure the settings and features are in line with what you expect, to be sure you can make an informed decision if you are considering purchasing the full game.

It is mainly quality of life improvements and performance optimization.


 All new menus with full controller support.
 Options to tweak how the game plays such mouse smoothing and quick turn can now be disabled or enabled as preferred.
 Added difficulty modifier settings.
 Added Audio Settings (currently, Overall, Music and UI settings are available, I'm working to add in game world sounds to this menu which will be in the EA launch of Beyond Hanwell).
 Added support for Nvidia DLSS super resolution and frame generation.
 The game will now try to check, and allow selection of any resolution your monitor supports, potentially opening up support for ultrawide, but I have no monitor to test this on, I'd be very interested to hear from anyone who can check this!
 Added FOV slider.
 Moved to Unreal Engine's new Enhanced Input system, and fixed previous bugs with Key Rebinding.
 Many many tweaks over the months to improve performance.


Thank you all for the incredible support and reception to the demo! Please check out the full game if you enjoyed it.
